title: Inside the Art and Soul Festival: Live Music, Good Food, and Pure Joy
description:
The Las Palmas Senior Center brought neighbors together for its vibrant Art and Soul Festival. The community event offered a welcoming space for locals of all ages to make art, enjoy music, and connect with neighborhood elders.

In addition to hosting community celebrations, the center provides ongoing physical and mental health services. Las Palmas keeps its doors open to anyone seeking health resources, strong friendships, or simply a fun place to relax.
